demo.title: borrow-against-fees
demo.code:
FD=https://FEEDESK_API_HOST
# quote (read-only)
curl -s "$FD/api/quote?token=0xTOKEN&borrower=0xYOU"
# apply: sign the 5-line applyMessage as the borrower, then 3 LLM personas on the Bankr LLM Gateway write credit memos
MSG="$(printf 'Gadai: apply for a loan against my creator fees\nToken: %s\nBorrower: %s\nController: %s\nNonce: %s' 0xtoken 0xyou 0xyou "$NONCE")"
bankr wallet sign --type personal_sign --message "$MSG"
curl -s -X POST "$FD/api/loans" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"token":"0xTOKEN","borrower":"0xYOU","via":"bankr-skill","nonce":"NONCE","signature":"0xSIG"}'
# → { "id": LOAN_ID, "vault": "0xVAULT", "pledgeTx": {...} }. Pledge fee rights to the loan's FeeVault (Bankr chat phrase):
# > transfer my beneficiary share on token 0xTOKEN to 0xVAULT
curl -s -X POST "$FD/api/loans/LOAN_ID/pledge" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"txHash":"0x..."}'
# funded by a FeeNote CCA, USDC arrives, then:
bankr llm credits add 20

setup: Your wallet must be the current fee beneficiary of a Base Doppler token launched on Bankr
Applying needs one personal_sign from that wallet (Bankr built-in signing, `bankr wallet sign`, or Wallet API /wallet/sign)
Pledging needs a raw transaction submit (Bankr built-in tool, `bankr wallet submit`, or /wallet/submit) or the Bankr chat phrase
